title: Arc
tagline: Arc: The ultimate no-code platform for swift creation, deployment & management of omnichain ERC721/1155 smart contracts. Powered by Layzero, ensuring seamless cross-chain compatibility & easy deployment on various blockchains. Blockchain simplicity redefined.
description:
Arc: The ultimate no-code platform for swift creation, deployment & management of omnichain ERC721/1155 smart contracts. Powered by Layzero, ensuring seamless cross-chain compatibility & easy deployment on various blockchains. Blockchain simplicity redefined.

1) Arc simplifies complex smart contract creation and management, catering to both novices and experts. It focuses on crafting intricate ERC721/1155 token contracts. The standout feature is Layzero integration, enabling seamless communication across diverse blockchains. This integration empowers Arc's contracts to function across multiple chains, eradicating the limitations of single-chain operations.

2) Effortless multi-chain deployment is a highlight. Developed contracts can be deployed across various blockchains with a single click. This eliminates the need for extensive technical configurations, enhancing accessibility and usability.

3) Arc further streamlines omnichain minting by automating token distribution across different networks. The platform includes built-in functionalities for minting tokens and facilitating cross-chain transactions, thus augmenting contract practicality.

In essence, Arc democratizes advanced intelligent contract management, leveraging Layzero for cross-chain capabilities. It simplifies deployment, distribution, and minting while maintaining user-friendly accessibility—a robust toolkit for harnessing smart contract potential without grappling with intricate technicalities.
how_its_made:
Arc's development is powered by a blend of cutting-edge technologies, including the MERN stack, IPFS, and the Layerzero protocol. At the front end, React.js ensures a smooth and intuitive user experience. Express and Node.js are leveraged to construct endpoints, facilitating seamless interactions between on-chain and off-chain components. The utilization of MongoDB aids in replicating on-chain transaction data for efficient off-chain utilization.

Incorporating IPFS contributes to decentralized file storage, enhancing security and accessibility. The centerpiece of cross-chain functionality, Layerzero's relayers, seamlessly facilitate the transmission of transactions across diverse blockchain networks, ensuring a harmonious interoperability.

Furthermore, Arc's architecture includes a factory contract, serving as a template for the creation and deployment of smart contracts. This comprehensive technological orchestration lies at the core of Arc's remarkable ability to simplify the complexities of smart contract management, ensuring a user-friendly and efficient platform.
